_about: Every tuning value from the playable pilot (docs/pilot/index.html, version 7, Oct 2026). Units: distances in metres (1 pilot unit = 1 m), times in seconds, rates per second unless named otherwise, opinions and needs 0-1, belief 0-100, alignment -1 (cruel) to +1 (kind). Seed data/ from this file, then tune in Godot. Where the pilot ran its village sim once per second, the Godot SimClock runs at 10 Hz: divide per-tick amounts accordingly.

world._island_note: Domain-warped fbm island; land fades between 64 and 108 m from centre. Mountain peak about 30 m high. Keep this small scale for Milestone 1; every distance below was tuned against it.
world._gravity_note: Higher than real gravity on purpose: throws feel snappy at this scale. openblack uses 10.

villages.house_built_when: wood >= cost and population >= capacity - 1 and no building under construction

hand_and_camera.hand_lift: 1.8 * scale (mouse), plus 4.2 * scale on touch so the finger does not hide it

miracles.casting: Drag the orb from the altar into the world and let go. Dropping back on the altar cancels at no cost.

decision_scores.feed_village: 0.55 * op.feed_village * prox(d) * need   (need 1.25 if that store has < 30 food, else 0.55)
decision_scores.eat_villager: hunger * op.eat_villager * prox(d)   (villager within 55 m, not fleeing)

teaching.credit_rule: Credit the current action if it is past its first 2.5 s or past the approach phase; otherwise credit the action finished in the last 4.5 s; otherwise the one finished in the last 8 s; otherwise nothing ('What did I do?').
teaching.stroke_gesture: on the creature: at least 2 horizontal direction reversals, 130 px of path since the last stroke, peak speed under 2.1 px/ms; strength clamp(path / 420, 0.5, 1)
teaching.slap_gesture: on the creature: released within 450 ms, path over 45 px, average speed over 1.3 px/ms; strength clamp(speed / 3, 0.55, 1)
teaching.tap_creature_opens_mind: path under 14 px and under 500 ms

creature_growth.measured_pace: level 3 at about 1 minute, level 10 at about 9 minutes of active play (headless sim, kind play)

gentle.effect: food it delivers gives 50% more belief

green.effect: fields within 20 m of it ripen twice as fast

shepherd.effect: each delivery is witnessed like a miracle (base 4)

herald.effect: +0.45 prayer per s while within 25 m of the stone circle or 28 m of an owned village

colossus.effect: size x1.15 and every deed counts x1.5 for belief

dread.effect: when it eats a villager, neutral villages within 70 m gain 6 belief (fear)

hunter.effect: chases 35% faster and gives up after 25 s instead of 9

earthshaker.effect: throws 1.6x as far; each landing is witnessed (base 3)

tyrant.effect: neutral villages within 45 m gain 0.25 belief per s; owned ones lose 0.05 per s

forms.rule: The branch with the most talents names it; a tie names it Wildling; no talents is Young Beast.

city.plots: Up to 6 per village, in a ring at radius + 1 m between house slots, skipping spots within 5.5 m of a field, 13 m of the stone circle, or with more than 3.2 m of height difference across 3.6 m.
city.fire_damage: a finished building becomes a ruin at 50% of its wood cost that villagers rebuild; a scaffold loses 40% of its progress; belief -6 owned, -3 neutral

lodge.name: Woodcutter's Lodge
lodge.effect: every 20 s, if the store has under 40 wood, sends a woodcutter to the nearest tree within 55 m: 4 s to fell it, +4 wood at the store; the tree regrows after 150 s
lodge.drop: a tree gives 9 wood instead of 6

nursery.name: Nursery
nursery.drop: food triggers a birth at once if there is a free bed

temple.name: Temple
temple.effect: +0.3 prayer per s, +0.03 belief per s, +0.25 prayer per s per kneeling priest

tower.name: Watchtower
tower.effect: neutral villages within 130 m gain 0.05 belief per s; its villagers flee the creature from 22 m instead of 12 m
tower.drop: a villager walks to the nearest neutral village, preaches 40 s at +0.45 belief per s, then settles there

pen.name: Creature Pen
pen.effect: within village radius + 18 m the creature's hunger and tiredness grow at 0.6x and it earns 1.25x XP
pen.drop: food goes in the trough and calls the creature (see teaching.trough_meal)

wonder.name: Sun Spire or Ember Spire (by player alignment when finished)
wonder.effect: +1 prayer per s; every village +0.05 belief per s if owned, +0.15 if not

tutorial_goals: Drag the land to look around
Pick up a rock and throw it
Drag the wheat orb out to cast Harvest
Tap your creature to read its mind
Teach it: slap cruelty, stroke kindness
Let your creature feed a village on its own
Win over Cairnhold, the hill village
